items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Schmeling, Joe Louis, and all that.

ctx.x: Yeah, he gave me for my birthday one year. He said – I think I gave him something first, maybe a photograph or a painting or something like that. Oh, no, I gave him real boxers, old boxers. I don’t even know the guys, Max . . .
Schmeling, Joe Louis, and all that.
